liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (5 reviews): Reviewer's favorite Dark Star, likely the best of 1969, mixing psychedelic rock, jazz and bluegrass feels; The mid-Dark Star jam Jerry often used was heard here before Chicago's song of that kind appeared [6][10][11][13][14]
- **Death Don't Have No Mercy** (1 review): Reviewer returns to this show mainly for The Eleven and Death Don't Have No Mercy [14]
- **Midnight Hour** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Midnight Hour killer, with a nod to Pigpen [15]

## The recordings

- **gd1969-11-02.sbd.miller.32273.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 13 songs; 112 min; rated 4.5/5 by 14 [1]
- **gd1969-11-02.sbd.miller.32350.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 13 songs; 112 min; rated 4.37/5 by 19 [2]
- **gd69-11-02.sbd.goodbear.1125.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 6 songs; 74 min; rated 4.44/5 by 45 [3]

## Around the show

- Uploader notes a flaw in the recording and the tape contains only part of the show, per pub comments [3]
- Reviewer calls this a must-have for 1969 Dead fans despite only five songs circulating [5]
- Reviewer is surprised this Dark Star is missing from many fans' top-ten lists [6]
- The band played another excellent Dark Star only six days later [11]
- The jam near the end of this Dark Star returned in the 10/31/71 Dark Star on Dick's Picks 2 [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1969-11-02.sbd.miller.32273.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Disc 1: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat (44.1k) DDisc 2: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) D [1]
- **gd1969-11-02.sbd.miller.32350.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Disc 1: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat (44.1k) DDisc 2: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) D [2]
- **gd69-11-02.sbd.goodbear.1125.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Doug Johnson and Teddy "Good Bear"; source: Soundboard [3]
